Isolating the exponential term, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3}-\frac{3{e}^{2-3x}}{\sqrt{3}} & <-2\sqrt{3} \\ -\frac{3{e}^{2-3x}}{\sqrt{3}} & <-3\sqrt{3} \\ -3{e}^{2-3x} & <-3\sqrt{3}\cdot \sqrt{3} \\ -3{e}^{2-3x} & <-9 \\ {e}^{2-3x} & >3.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, taking the natural logarithm of both sides and applying the laws of logarithms, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡({e}^{2-3x}) & >\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ 2-3x & >\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ -3x & >\operatorname{ln}⁡3-2 \\ 3x & <2-\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ x & <\frac{1}{3}(2-\operatorname{ln}⁡3).\end{aligned}
$$
